preflight.rule: Reuse saved current-frame support faces. Retain all horizontal unit faces crossing the one fixed native column, every inside/outside label and visibility status. Scalar candidates are exact half-pixel face Y, not interpolated physical fronts. Missing/ambiguous physical identity remains NOT_EVALUATED; future role output requires independent current boundary selection.
preflight.simplicity: No new production API or settings: existing recipe center, saved arrays and existing level conversion suffice for this prototype. No alternate X, slope fit, visible-subset median, nearest reference or strongest-edge selection.
controls: all filtered faces equal an independent direct column-neighbor enumeration
same static surface with side-only visibility never substitutes a side Y
preflight.context: Whole original crop remains available for role recognition. The report source-column renderer uses a 40%-width RGB median and cannot be reused as a fixed-pixel numerical source; this separate direct array slice leaves it unchanged.
preflight.limits: A one-column spatial target is not a one-column-only material classifier. Raw support transitions include glass and texture. Half-pixel support boundaries are not newly accepted physical localization truth.

from pathlib import Path
import sys,os,json,hashlib,math
ROOT=Path('/Users/sunjaekim/Developer/oil_level_tracker');sys.path[:0]=[str(ROOT),str(ROOT/'src')]
os.environ.setdefault('MPLCONFIGDIR','/tmp/s11-seed-tracks-mpl')
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from oil_tracker.adapters.storage.json_recipe_repository import JsonRecipeRepository
from tests.diagnostics.s11_foam_support_geometry import measure_boundary_faces
OUT=ROOT/'sample/output/s11-fixed-center-20261009-001';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def write(n,v):(OUT/n).write_text(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
recipe=JsonRecipeRepository().load(ROOT/'sample/sample4.oilrecipe');geometry=recipe.glasses[0].geometry;center=int(math.floor(geometry.ellipse.center_x+.5))
cp=ROOT/'sample/output/s11-reference-current-perimeters-20261009-001';cr=json.loads((cp/'readout.json').read_text());old=json.loads((cp/'preflight.json').read_text());sourcepins=old['source_pins'];cases=[];seen=set();inputs={}
for p in [cp/'preflight.json',cp/'readout.json',ROOT/'sample/sample4.oilrecipe',ROOT/'docs/50-diagnostics/s11/2026-10-09-fixed-center-choice.json',ROOT/'tests/diagnostics/s11_foam_support_geometry.py']:inputs[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))]=sha(p)
for plan in cr['results']:
 for row in plan['rows']:
  f=row['frame']
  if f in seen:continue
  seen.add(f);cases.append({'id':f's4-f{f}','frame':f,'time_s':f/30,'source_x':center,'origin':[543,798],'face_origin':[543,798],'arrays_path':row['support_path'],'arrays_sha256':row['support_sha256'],'location_basis':'existing Recipe ellipse.center_x rounded to native column'})
public=ROOT/'sample/output/s11-support-faces-20261009-001';pp=json.loads((public/'preflight.json').read_text());pr=json.loads((public/'readout.json').read_text());pubrows={r['case_id']:r for r in pr['results']}
for p in [public/'preflight.json',public/'readout.json']:inputs[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))]=sha(p)
for c in pp['cases']:
 if 'native' not in c['case_id']:continue
 r=pubrows[c['case_id']];x0,y0,x1,y1=c['crop_xyxy'];cx=int(math.floor((x0+x1)/2+.5));ident=c['source_identity']
 cases.append({'id':c['case_id'],'frame':ident['frame_index'],'time_s':ident['source_raster']['nominal_time_sec'],'source_x':cx,'origin':[x0,y0],'face_origin':[0,0],'arrays_path':r['arrays_path'],'arrays_sha256':r['arrays_sha256'],'location_basis':'fixed previously declared diagnostic crop center; no calibrated public Recipe or production geometry asserted','source_identity':ident})
for c in cases:inputs[c['arrays_path']]=c['arrays_sha256']
pre={'schema':'s11-fixed-center-readout-preflight-v1','base_head':'67d2ad3959fd2e912b485cf0c336be0f5e7145e5','policy':'fixed-glass-center-native-column-v1','cases':cases,'inputs':inputs,'source_pins':sourcepins,'runner_sha256':sha(Path(__file__)),
 'rule':'Reuse saved current-frame support faces. Retain all horizontal unit faces crossing the one fixed native column, every inside/outside label and visibility status. Scalar candidates are exact half-pixel face Y, not interpolated physical fronts. Missing/ambiguous physical identity remains NOT_EVALUATED; future role output requires independent current boundary selection.',
 'simplicity':'No new production API or settings: existing recipe center, saved arrays and existing level conversion suffice for this prototype. No alternate X, slope fit, visible-subset median, nearest reference or strongest-edge selection.',
 'controls':['all filtered faces equal an independent direct column-neighbor enumeration','same static surface with side-only visibility never substitutes a side Y','masked center is censored','multiple current intersections stay multiple','coordinate translation','existing independent px/mm conversion'],
 'context':'Whole original crop remains available for role recognition. The report source-column renderer uses a 40%-width RGB median and cannot be reused as a fixed-pixel numerical source; this separate direct array slice leaves it unchanged.',
 'limits':'A one-column spatial target is not a one-column-only material classifier. Raw support transitions include glass and texture. Half-pixel support boundaries are not newly accepted physical localization truth.',
 'partition':'development','video_decode':False,'detector_run':False,'production_change':False,'ml_used':False}
for p,pin in {**inputs,**sourcepins}.items():assert sha(ROOT/p)==pin,p
write('preflight.json',pre);(OUT/'run.py').write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
# The fixed-column query deliberately delegates face construction to the existing owner.
def query(b,column):
 return np.flatnonzero((b['owner_pixel_xy'][:,0]==column)&(b['outward_normal_xy'][:,0]==0))
controls=[]
a=np.zeros((9,11),np.uint16);a[3:6,2:9]=1;v=np.ones_like(a,bool)
b=measure_boundary_faces(a,v);ids=query(b,5);assert sorted((b['owner_pixel_xy'][ids,1]+b['outward_normal_xy'][ids,1]/2).tolist())==[2.5,5.5];controls.append({'name':'multiple_intersections_retained','result':'PASS','y':[2.5,5.5],'role_output':None})
sides=v.copy();sides[:,3:8]=False;b=measure_boundary_faces(a,sides);assert not len(query(b,5));controls.append({'name':'only_sides_visible_no_x_fallback','result':'PASS','fixed_column_candidates':0})
masked=v.copy();masked[2,5]=False;b=measure_boundary_faces(a,masked);q=query(b,5);assert any(b['status'][q]==2);controls.append({'name':'masked_neighbour_remains_censored','result':'PASS'})
b=measure_boundary_faces(a,v,origin=(13,21));ids=query(b,18);assert sorted((b['owner_pixel_xy'][ids,1]+b['outward_normal_xy'][ids,1]/2).tolist())==[23.5,26.5];controls.append({'name':'coordinate_translation','result':'PASS'})
assert geometry.level_px_from_zero(None) is None and geometry.level_px_from_zero(842.5)==7.5 and geometry.level_mm_from_zero(842.5,.2)==1.5
controls.append({'name':'existing_level_conversion_and_missingness','result':'PASS','actual_output_rule_executed':False});write('controls.json',controls)
results=[];cache={}
for c in cases:
 with np.load(ROOT/c['arrays_path'],allow_pickle=False) as a:b={k:a[k].copy() for k in a.files}
 origin=np.array(c['origin']);fo=np.array(c['face_origin']);dxdy=origin-fo;column=c['source_x']-int(dxdy[0]);localx=c['source_x']-int(origin[0]);h,w=b['labels'].shape;assert 0<=localx<w
 ids=query(b,column);ys=b['owner_pixel_xy'][ids,1]+b['outward_normal_xy'][ids,1]/2+dxdy[1]
 actual=set((int(b['owner_pixel_xy'][i,1]+dxdy[1]),int(b['outward_normal_xy'][i,1]),int(b['inside_label'][i]),int(b['outside_label'][i]),int(b['status'][i])) for i in ids)
 expected=set();labels=b['labels'][:,localx];visible=b['visible'][:,localx]
 for y in np.flatnonzero(visible&(labels>0)):
  for dy in [-1,1]:
   yy=y+dy
   if not 0<=yy<h:other,status=0,3
   elif not visible[yy]:other,status=0,2
   else:
    other=int(labels[yy]);status=0 if other==0 else 1
    if other==labels[y]:continue
   expected.add((int(y+origin[1]),dy,int(labels[y]),other,status))
 assert actual==expected and len(actual)==len(ids),c['id']
 intersections=[{'face_id':int(i),'source_y':float(y),'inside_label':int(b['inside_label'][i]),'outside_label':int(b['outside_label'][i]),'outward_y':int(b['outward_normal_xy'][i,1]),'status':['VISIBLE_ZERO','VISIBLE_OTHER_LABEL','MASKED_NEIGHBOUR','CROP'][b['status'][i]],'physical_role':'UNRESOLVED'} for i,y in zip(ids,ys,strict=True)]
 r={'case_id':c['id'],'frame':c['frame'],'source_x':c['source_x'],'intersections':intersections,'visible_column_pixels':int(visible.sum()),'height':h,'observed_intersections':int((b['status'][ids]<=1).sum()),'censored_intersections':int((b['status'][ids]>1).sum()),'selected_oil_y':None,'selected_foam_y':None,'decision':'NOT_EVALUATED'};results.append(r);cache[c['id']]=(b,c,r)
for name,frames in [('foam',list(range(420,511))),('oil',list(range(1275,1351)))]:
 columns=[];marks=[]
 for f in frames:
  b,c,r=cache[f's4-f{f}'];lx=c['source_x']-c['origin'][0];columns.append(b['crop'][:,lx,::-1]);marks.extend((f/30,item['source_y'],item['outward_y'],item['status']) for item in r['intersections'])
 raster=np.stack(columns,axis=1);np.savez_compressed(OUT/(name+'-time-column.npz'),rgb=raster,frames=np.array(frames),source_x=center)
 fig,axs=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(11,7),layout='constrained',sharex=True,sharey=True)
 for ax in axs:ax.imshow(raster,extent=((frames[0]-.5)/30,(frames[-1]+.5)/30,901.5,797.5),aspect='auto',interpolation='nearest');ax.set_ylabel('source Y')
 for x,y,normal,status in marks:axs[1].scatter(x,y,s=8,c=('#00ffff' if normal<0 else '#ff9900') if status.startswith('VISIBLE') else '#ff00ff',marker='.')
 axs[0].set_title(f'Original RGB at fixed source X={center}; each time column is one frame');axs[1].set_title('All current support crossings: upward cyan / downward orange / censored magenta');axs[1].set_xlabel('time (s)');fig.suptitle('Fixed measurement location; no selected Oil/Foam boundary');fig.savefig(OUT/(name+'-time-column.png'),dpi=130);plt.close(fig)
# Whole-image visual context for the later unreviewed Foam endpoint; overlay every center crossing.
picks=[495,503,510];fig,axs=plt.subplots(2,3,figsize=(11,7),layout='constrained')
for j,f in enumerate(picks):
 b,c,r=cache[f's4-f{f}'];ex=(542.5,646.5,901.5,797.5)
 for z in [0,1]:axs[z,j].imshow(b['crop'][:,:,::-1],extent=ex,interpolation='nearest');axs[z,j].set_title(f'{f/30:g}s / f{f}'+(' original' if z==0 else ' center crossings'),fontsize=9)
 axs[1,j].axvline(center,c='#888888',lw=.7)
 for item in r['intersections']:
  if not item['status'].startswith('VISIBLE'):continue
  axs[1,j].plot([center-3,center+3],[item['source_y']]*2,c='#00ffff' if item['outward_y']<0 else '#ff9900',lw=2)
fig.suptitle('All center support boundaries, not a physical front claim');fig.savefig(OUT/'foam-later-center-context.png',dpi=150);plt.close(fig)
for p,pin in {**inputs,**sourcepins}.items():assert sha(ROOT/p)==pin,p
write('readout.json',{'schema':'s11-fixed-center-readout-v1','results':results,'cases':len(cases),'all_intersections_checked':sum(len(r['intersections']) for r in results),'observed_intersections':sum(r['observed_intersections'] for r in results),'censored_intersections':sum(r['censored_intersections'] for r in results),'input_and_production_pins_preserved':True,'scope':'geometry/projection prerequisite, not a physical classifier','figures':{str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(p) for p in OUT.glob('*.png')}})
print({'cases':len(cases),'intersections':sum(len(r['intersections']) for r in results),'COMPLETE':str(OUT)})
